key.name: toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the power menu.

key.name: layout
key.description: How the power menu buttons are arranged: row, list, grid or split.

key.name: backdrop
key.description: Effect applied behind the menu: none, dim, blur, blur and dim, or accent tint.

key.name: backdrop-strength
key.description: How strong the dim, blur or tint is, from 0 to 100 percent.

key.name: confirm-mode
key.description: Hold the key to confirm, or press it once to start a cancelable countdown.

key.name: countdown-secs
key.description: Length of the countdown used when the confirmation mode is countdown.

key.name: hold-ms
key.description: How long a key must be held to confirm an action. 0 runs the action instantly.

key.name: show-lock
key.description: Show the Lock button in the menu.

key.name: key-lock
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Lock.

key.name: show-switch
key.description: Show the Switch User button in the menu.

key.name: key-switch
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Switch User.

key.name: show-logout
key.description: Show the Log Out button in the menu.

key.name: key-logout
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Log Out.

key.name: show-sleep
key.description: Show the Sleep button in the menu.

key.name: key-sleep
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Sleep.

key.name: show-hibernate
key.description: Show the Hibernate button when the system supports hibernation.

key.name: key-hibernate
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Hibernate.

key.name: show-restart
key.description: Show the Restart button in the menu.

key.name: key-restart
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Restart.

key.name: show-poweroff
key.description: Show the Power Off button in the menu.

key.name: key-poweroff
key.description: Single letter or digit that triggers Power Off.
